summary: Fix inconsistent validation of empty text in Todo class
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='') raises ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'
Todo(id=1, text='   ') raises ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'
Existing valid text cases still work
implementation_notes: Added text validation in __post_init__ and from_dict to reject empty/whitespace-only text, consistent with rename() method. Also added whitespace stripping for consistency across all text entry points.
